Headline: #12 Roosevelt, #18 16th/18th, and #192 U. of Chicago/Hospitals Express buses Temporary Eastbound Reroute near Roosevelt/Clark
ShortDescription: EB #12 Roosevelt, #18 16th/18th, and #192 U. of Chicago/Hospitals Express buses are temporarily rerouted, due to a street blockage near Roosevelt/Clark.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
How does this affect my trip?

The Eastbound #12 Roosevelt, #18 16th/18th, and #192 U. of Chicago/Hospitals Express buses are temporarily rerouted.

Eastbound buses will operate via Roosevelt, Clark, Polk, State, then resume their normal route on Roosevelt.

Westbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Why is service being changed?

Buses are rerouted due to a street blockage near Roosevelt/Clark.

Headline: Yellow, Purple, and Red Lines Service Delayed at Howard
ShortDescription: Yellow, Purple, and Red Line trains are standing at Howard due to signal problems. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Yellow, Purple, and Red Line trains are experiencing a delay at Howard due to signal problems.

Shuttle buses are available between Howard and Skokie to provide connecting service for the Yellow Lines.

Shuttle buses have been requested for Howard and Thorndale to provide connecting service for the Red Lines and Howard to Linden for the Purple Lines.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#151 Sheridan 

#22 Clark

#97 Skokie

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.
